query:
SELECT s.id, s.title, s.status
            FROM survey.survey s
            JOIN survey.survey_campaign link
              ON link.org_id = s.org_id AND link.survey_id = s.id AND link.campaign_id = $2
            WHERE s.org_id = $1
            ORDER BY s.created_at DESC, s.id DESC
            LIMIT $3 OFFSET $4
